meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将已有小说反向解析为标准写作项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你已有写好的小说草稿，想用专业工具继续完善
copy.tagline_en: Reverse-import existing novels into a standard writing project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a draft novel and want to continue with professional writing tools

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把你已经写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析成标准项目目录结构，包括设定、大纲、正文、追踪等文件，让你可以直接用其他写作技能续写。
howto.when: 当你说“/story-import”、“导入小说”、“反向解析”、“导入”或“把我的书导进来”时触发。

say.text: 导入我写的小说，文件路径是 /path/to/novel.txt。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析并重建项目结构。

say.text: 反向解析这本短篇小说，文本如下：……
say.note: Claude 会按短篇流程拆解并迁移。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can reverse-parse your existing novel (draft or complete) into a standard project directory structure including settings, outline, text, and tracking files, allowing you to continue writing with other story skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/story-import", "import novel", "reverse parse", "import", or "bring my book in".

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and rebuild the project structure.

say_en.text: Reverse parse this short story, text: ...
say_en.note: Claude will follow the short story pipeline.
